subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move the same information to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery out of the UI?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the linked request leaves placement open and the change makes an absolute local path prominent in a user-facing page.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land the display-only row after the contributor adds redacted running-Control-UI proof and resolves the current conflict.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing snapshot field to be surfaced in a less prominent settings/config information area.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline the UI exposure and rely on the already merged config-path troubleshooting surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land the display-only row after the contributor adds redacted running-Control-UI proof and resolves the current conflict.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview presentation surface receiving this row.
